Name: Seasonal Seed Packets
Author: seaf0ampudding
Description:
Welcome to Kayla's Seasonal Tool Recolors, a content patcher mod made to reduce seed confusion.

Each season uses the wild seeds color palette to keep consistency.
Green= Spring
Pink= Summer
Orange=Fall

Trellis crops follow the same coloring conventions but instead coloring the top of the trellis and not the seed bag. These changes are not reflected once the crop is planted, and is only visible in the inventory sprite.

Cactus seeds have been colored grey to show that they are only able to be planted inside.

Seeds without a trellis or a seed bag (mixed seeds, rice shoots, sunflower seeds, tea sapling, and coffee bean) do not have a seasonal indication mark.

Rare seeds have also not been marked.

Some seeds are difficult to see the mark and I do apologize for that, if it doesn't look like they've been changed it just means that the season's colors and the bag colors are just extremely similar.

Issues with/ suggestions for the mod? Email me at 00spongeboblover00224@gmail.com
